'''Finegan Flint''' was the leader of the [[The Knights|Knights]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], which he named after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. He was tall and thin, which gave him an unusual appearance for a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang leader. Flint had short [[Color/Legends|black]] hair, with a long moustache and beard. He always wore a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] with "Knights" on the back of it. Most of the time he was a calm man, but in combat, Finegan Flint fought like a wild man. The purposes of his swoop gang were also quite different than most swoop gangs. He opposed and battled the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as other swoop gangs such as [[The Skulls]].
